mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

No version numbering scheme is currently recorded for this project. Earlier decisions on the scheme were subsequently withdrawn, so no decision stands, and this document will be updated once a new one is recorded.

cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says that no version numbering scheme is currently recorded.

The project memory holds two decisions on the scheme, made in order. A later entry (#13) withdrew the whole series of technology decisions and lists the versioning scheme among them. With that withdrawal, no decision stands. The file doesn't name the retired schemes or give a value.

My first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool. The file now exists and I haven't committed it.
